texts.zh: 在扫描小行星带的时候，我们的科研小队发现了一些不寻常的东西。
texts.en: While scanning the asteroid belt our science team found some sort of irregularity.

sections.zh: 在扫描小行星带的时候，我们的科研小队发现了一些不寻常的东西。
sections.en: While scanning the asteroid belt our science team found some sort of irregularity.

texts.zh: 尽管宛如大海捞针，[Root.GetName]精确地找出了那个穿过了小行星带的奇怪信号的来源。信号来源于一个小型外星物品。简单的扫描显示出它是一种仪式性的容器，里面装着某位外星宇航员的遗体。
texts.en: By what has to be beyond astronomical odds, the [Root.GetName] actually managed to pinpoint the source of the odd signals as it soared past through the asteroid belt. A tiny, alien construct. A simple scan reveals that it is some sort of a ritualistic container, holding the remains of an alien spacefarer.

label.zh: 让那个棺材继续它的旅途吧。
label.en: Let the coffin continue its voyage.

label.zh: 打开棺材，研究那具尸体。
label.en: Open the coffin and study the corpse.

label.en: Bring it to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] and display it in a museum.

label.zh: 日后与被亵渎遗体的帝国建立通讯时
label.en: When communications are later established with the empire whose dead were defiled

label.zh: 有很多值得学习的东西。打开荚舱。
label.en: There is much to learn. Open the pod.

texts.zh:
距离我们和[DefiledCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]第一次接触已经过去几天了，现在他们向我们发来了一则消息：

“我们知道你们做了什么，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们开启的那个棺材是我们第一位星际宇航员最后的休憩之处。我们要求你们道歉！”
texts.en:
A couple of days have passed since we first made contact with the [DefiledCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and now they are sending us a message:

"We know what you have done, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The casket you desecrated was the final resting place of our first star traveler. We demand an apology!"

tooltips.zh: 你们之间的关系会受到影响。

label.zh: 我们会为你们祖先的灵魂祈祷。
label.en: We will pray for the spirit of your ancestor.

tooltips.zh: 你们之间的关系会受到影响。

label.en: It is merely a dead body.

tooltips.zh: 你们之间的关系会受到影响。

label.zh: 异星杂种，我们根本就不在乎！
label.en: We could not care less, alien scum!

tooltips.zh: 你们之间的关系会受到影响。

texts.zh:
我们在围绕着[From.GetName]的小行星中发现了一艘外星飞船在那里漂泊。它对我们的联络新号毫无反应。它到底是无法解析我们的信号，还是可能因为其他原因无视我们，我们无从得知。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议我们派遣一艘工程船来，将其拖出碎片区。要是不管它的话，这艘外星飞船很可能会被小行星撞碎。

已发布一项特殊项目去拯救飞船并调查它。
texts.en:
We have discovered an alien ship adrift among the asteroids surrounding [From.GetName]. It is not responding to our hailing signals. Whether this is due to it being unable to interpret our signal, or perhaps some other reason, we do not know.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] recommends that a construction ship be dispatched to tow this stricken vessel out of the debris field. If left untouched, there is a risk the alien ship may be crushed by the asteroids.

A Special Project has been issued to rescue and investigate the ship.

texts.zh: 一艘外星飞船在小行星带中漂泊。它并没有回应呼叫。我们应该调查到底发生了什么。
texts.en: An alien ship is drifting inside an asteroid belt. It will not respond to hails. We should investigate and see what is going on.

texts.zh:
漂泊在[From.From.From.GetName]的飞船被拖拉出来，我们得以派遣特遣队去调查它。里面发生过一场谋杀。只找到了一位船员的尸体——那是一个长耳朵的两栖双腿生物，他身上有多处刺伤。该舰船因为没有了主人，已归我们所有。

该舰船拥有非常高效的推进器，它的架构和设计都高于我们当前的水准。飞船没有装备武器，看来是一艘运送重要人员的运输船。

把它改造成勘探船无需花费多大功夫。不过，如果我们拆毁它并仔细研究它的引擎，也许就能够对我们的舰队水平有实际提升。
texts.en:
Once the ship drifting by [From.From.From.GetName] was towed out of the debris, we were able to send in an away team to investigate. They uncovered a murder scene. Only one crew member has been found - a long-eared, amphibian biped who appears to have been stabbed repeatedly.

With its crew evidently dead, the ship is now up for grabs. It is fitted with very efficient thrusters, the structure and design of which are beyond us at present. The vessel is not armed, seemingly having been used as a transport for important personnel.

Repurposing it into an exploration vessel would be a minor undertaking. However, if we deconstruct it and study the engines in greater detail, we may instead be able to apply its ingenious design to our own fleets.

label.en: Repurpose it into a science vessel.
Tear it down and study the engines.

texts.zh: 很遗憾，未能抢救靠近[From.From.From.GetName]的漂流船。一个未侦测到的小行星突然出现在碰撞航向上，把那艘船撞成了碎片。
texts.en: Sadly we were not able to save the drifting ship close to [From.From.From.GetName] before it was too late. An untracked asteroid appeared on a collision course and smashed the ship to pieces.

# 古怪读数 / Odd Readings

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/anomalies/02_anomaly_categories.txt:56-74` · `events/anomaly_events_3.txt:274-546 (4015-4018)` · `events/anomaly_events_3.txt:2643-2727 (4085-4086)` · `common/special_projects/00_projects_3.txt:217-248` · `events/failures.txt:270-295` · `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2265-2269`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-12（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 6级异常；在小行星上以权重3生成。  
  Level-6 anomaly; spawn weight 3 on asteroids.
- 约30天后另有一份通用联络报告（story.1–8，共享枢纽故事），不属于本故事。  
  About 30 days later a generic contact report (story.1–8, a shared hub story) follows; it is not part of this story.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 两个结果各权重1：  
  Two outcomes, weight 1 each:
- **最后休憩**（4015）：小行星带中一具外星航天员的仪式棺椁。任其继续航行（社会学研究）；或打开研究（非狂热亲外、非进化掠食者）/ 带回博物馆展出（狂热亲外或纪念主义者）/ 进化掠食者打开舱体：三者都获得研究，并由隐藏事件4018在1–8跳内给一个尚未接触的帝国记下“亵渎遗体”。  
  **The Final Rest** (4015): an alien spacefarer's ritual coffin. Let it drift (society research), or open it / display it in a museum (fanatic xenophile or memorialist) / open the pod (Evolutionary Predators): these give research, and hidden 4018 marks an uncontacted empire 1–8 jumps away as having had its dead defiled.
- **漂泊**（4085）：小行星间一艘漂流外星飞船。救援 → 45天项目（需工程船或方舟舰队，限时1080天），或拆解得合金。  
  **Adrift** (4085): a drifting alien ship. Rescue it (45-day project; constructor or arkship; 1,080-day limit) or scrap it for alloys.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 救援完成 → 4086 船员遭谋杀的现场：改装为信使级科研船，或拆解研究引擎（陆军移动速度修正）。超时 → anomaly_failure.4086 小行星撞毁飞船。  
  Rescue → 4086 a murder scene: refit it as a Courier science ship or study its engines; on timeout anomaly_failure.4086 an asteroid destroys it.
- 若此后与被亵渎遗体的帝国建立通讯：on_post_communications_established 触发隐藏 4016，5天后 4017：对方帝国当面谴责（窗口标题为对方国名），好感下降（按思潮措辞）。4017 也出现在通用通讯故事中。  
  If communications are later established with that empire: hidden 4016 (on_post_communications_established) fires 4017 five days later: that empire confronts us (the window title is its name), lowering their opinion. 4017 also appears in the generic communications story.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- anomaly_failure.4086 对唯物或尚武帝国另有“货物更重要”选项。  
  anomaly_failure.4086 offers materialist or militarist empires "The cargo was more important".

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：类别、4015–4018、4085/4086、项目、失败事件与通讯建立回调。  
  Category, 4015–4018, 4085/4086, project, failure event and the communications on_action.
- 更正 Corrections：新增4015三个“打开/展出”选项到4017的状态连接（亵渎遗体的后果），原来缺失。  
  Added the state-triggered link from the three "open/display" options of 4015 to 4017 (the consequence of defiling the corpse), previously missing.
- 覆盖 Coverage：7 个文档全部核对 / all 7 docs checked.
